name: Summoner Tale
summary: Summoner Tale is an Action RPG that redefines monster-taming with new, immersive way. Play a young summoner on a perilous journey to uncover hidden truths and restore balance. Befriend and command powerful monsters, harness their unique abilities, and forge unbreakable bonds as you build your ultimate squad. Battle through a world on the brink, where every encounter shapes your destiny!
